objective: Test three unconventional morning information-flow geometries that are not parameter repairs of prior SPY/UPRO/SPXU failures.

consumed_and_prohibited: raw within-day volume clock or volume-share acceleration
path straightness, tortuosity, and record topology
binary activity masks, synchronization, silence entropy, and run lengths
research_lineage.new_information: All v10 scores preserve temporal ordering between historically normalized dollar flow and price. Earlier rules either collapsed volume to a centroid/share, collapsed price to a return/path-efficiency statistic, or used unordered multivariate similarity.

account_and_execution.position: long fractional UPRO for a positive score or long fractional SPXU for a negative score
account_and_execution.signal_delay: 09:30-10:29 is completed, 10:30 is a dead decision minute, and entry occurs at 10:31

data.price_sensor: Databento ARCX.PILLAR SPY OHLCV-1m and UPRO/SPXU BBO-1m
data.consolidated_execution_audit: Databento EQUS.MINI UPRO/SPXU BBO-1m where available, with ARCA signals unchanged

shared_definitions.morning_minutes: 09:30 through 10:29 inclusive, represented on a fixed 60-minute clock
shared_definitions.missing_trade_bar: zero dollar flow for that exchange-minute
shared_definitions.historical_scale: median total morning dollar flow for the same ETF over the prior 20 eligible sessions
shared_definitions.normalized_minute_flow: minute dollar flow divided by historical scale
shared_definitions.relative_flow: (normalized UPRO flow - normalized SPXU flow) / (normalized UPRO flow + normalized SPXU flow), zero when the denominator is zero
shared_definitions.spy_minute_return: log current SPY close divided by prior SPY close within the morning window
shared_definitions.etf_midpoint_return_path: cumulative log BBO-midpoint return from 09:30; exact valid quotes required for all 60 minutes

relative_dollar_flow_surprise.score: current UPRO total morning dollar flow / prior-20 median UPRO morning flow minus the analogous SPXU ratio
relative_dollar_flow_surprise.trade: buy UPRO if score is positive and SPXU if negative; skip exact ties
relative_dollar_flow_surprise.economic_claim: Unusually large capital participation relative to each vehicle's own recent baseline identifies which leveraged exposure is undergoing the stronger inventory transfer. Cross-session normalization removes persistent price, split, and liquidity differences that invalidated raw volume comparisons.

price_volume_phase_compass.per_etf_area: For cumulative midpoint log return p and cumulative normalized flow share v, calculate the discrete signed area sum(p_previous * delta_v - v_previous * delta_p).
price_volume_phase_compass.score: SPXU signed area minus UPRO signed area, so the ETF with the more negative area is selected
price_volume_phase_compass.trade: buy UPRO if score is positive and SPXU if negative; skip exact ties
price_volume_phase_compass.economic_claim: A more negative price-volume area means capital arrived earlier than the corresponding price displacement. That ordering is interpreted as unfinished price response to inventory, unlike VWAP, volume centroid, or path straightness.

lagged_flow_price_transfer.score: sum of prior-minute relative_flow times the next SPY minute log return across the completed morning
lagged_flow_price_transfer.trade: buy UPRO if score is positive and SPXU if negative; skip exact ties
lagged_flow_price_transfer.economic_claim: The sign measures whether relative UPRO participation consistently preceded upward SPY changes or relative SPXU participation preceded downward changes. It is a within-session causal-transfer statistic, not the sign of the morning return.

benchmarks.passive_spy: price-only fractional SPY from first 09:30 open to final 15:59 close over identical calendar partitions
benchmarks.always_upro_same_window: buy UPRO at 10:31 ask and sell at 15:55 bid every eligible session

diagnostic_extension: 2026-01-02 through 2026-07-24; not independent of the broader repository research program

requirements: no weekday, year, direction, volatility, spread, or score-magnitude filter
no combination of candidates after outcomes

cash_settlement_warning: The economic simulation assumes the full account can be redeployed each eligible session. Literal cash-account settlement and good-faith restrictions are an additional operational constraint.
